requirements.text: The system shall ensure secure authentication and data encryption to protect sensitive student attendance data.
The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict data access based on user roles.
The system shall provide real-time data synchronization with adaptive energy-saving measures during peak loads.
The system shall allow students to view their attendance records after successful authentication.
The system shall generate attendance reports within 5 seconds for up to 1000 students.
The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations when handling student attendance data.
The system shall maintain historical attendance data for a minimum of five academic years to comply with educational regulations.
The system shall provide logging mechanisms for all attendance modifications and access to ensure accountability.
The system shall implement automated alerts for discrepancies in attendance reporting.
The system shall notify students of their attendance status via email or app notification within 24 hours.
The system shall allow students to dispute attendance records through a formal process within 10 days.
